artifacts.summary: Promoted the two-origin cone-topology side and the named hedgehog inequality, added the frame-level and formulation-bridge declarations, raised the theorem index to citation granularity, and produced the appendix support table.
The headline deliverable: each element of the manuscript's topology appendix against the Lean declaration that certifies it, with axiom profiles, plus every statement the library does not certify.

completion_data.completion_summary: Closed the state-topology collection's promotion gap (the two-origin frame's cone-topology side, including not_triangle and the frame-level coincidence, plus the named hedgehog inequality in both the != and strict-fineness forms), added the four frame-level declarations and two formulation bridges the revised appendix cites, raised docs/theorem-index.md from 5 topology rows to 42, and produced the appendix support table at docs/reference/state-topology-appendix-support.md keyed by paper label rather than line number. Twenty new library declarations, all sorry-free with standard axioms; a new leaf test module gives the collection its first in-tree consumer and pins nine axiom profiles. All four acceptance gates green: lake build --wfail over the library (2722 jobs) and Tests/BimodalTest (2782 jobs) with zero warnings, check-module-invariants.sh ALL CHECKS PASSED, mk_all --check exit 0.
